data.source_title: नन्हे हमिंगबर्ड का कमाल! 38 दिनों में 6526 KM उड़कर पहुंचा अलास्का, वैज्ञानिक भी हैरान
data.sub: Hummingbird 38 dino me 6526 km udkar Alaska pahuncha

chat.say: Alaska pahunch gaya bhai, bilkul non-stop!
Idhar bed se fridge jane me saans phool gayi

data.asar: Gym jane me aalas aata hai aur ye 6526 KM ud gaya
data.caption:
Itna chhota sa pakshi aur itna bada safar! 🤯

• Nanhe hummingbird ne 38 dino mein 6526 KM ki flight bhar li
• Alaska tak ka safar pura karke scientists ko hairan kar diya
• Itni lambi doori tay karna kisi chamatkar se kam nahi

Yahan hum bed se uthkar paani peene ke liye bhi aalsi ban jaate hain. 😴

Dost ko tag karo jo 500 meter chalkar bhi thak jaata hai! 👇
